🧬 Learning

Evolutionary algorithm

In simple words

A way of solving problems that copies evolution: the best of many tries are kept, mixed and slightly changed, generation after generation.

A way of finding good solutions by copying evolution. It starts with many random tries, keeps the best ones, mixes them, changes them a little at random, and repeats this for many generations. Genetic algorithms are the best-known kind. When the tries are neural networks, it is called neuroevolution.

Example. Plant breeders keep the seeds of the sweetest tomatoes and cross the plants, year after year. In a game, the same idea can evolve little cars: the ones that drive furthest become the parents of the next generation.

Related words

  • Gradient descentA way to train a model by changing its parameters, step by step, in the direction that makes the loss smaller.
  • Reinforcement learningLearning by trial and error: an AI tries actions and gets rewards or penalties for the results.
